tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Interior Hölder norm estimate] 1. ch8:8.24\group ch08-generalized-solutions Under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.22, for every $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $, egin{equation} \| u\| _{C^\alpha (\overline{\Omega '})} \leq C(\| u\| _{L^2(\Omega )}+k), ag {8.68} \end{equation} where $d'=\dist (\Omega ',\partial \Omega )$, $C=C(n,\Lambda /\lambda , u ,q,d')$, $\alpha =\alpha (n,\Lambda /\lambda , u d')>0$, and $k=\lambda ^{-1}(\| f\| _q+\| g\| _{q/2})$.
Proof

\sketch Use Theorem 8.22 with radius comparable to $d'$ and Theorem 8.17 to bound the local supremum by the global $L^2$ norm and the data.

□
